body:
Root cause: C:\Users\leon7\AppData\Local\hermes\active_profile contained project-c (sticky state from a prior session). Desktop passed --profile project-c, but cmd_dashboard read the file via get_active_profile_name(), saw a non-default profile, and triggered os.execvpe — re-execing with -p default --open-profile project-c. On Windows os.execvpe spawns a child process (orphaned) while the original exits with code 0. Electron interpreted the exit as "backend exited before it became ready (0)".

Fix (hermes_cli/main.py:10277-10285): Added a guard — if HERMES_HOME already points into a profiles/ directory, profile routing was already done upstream (by desktop or -p flag) and re-exec is skipped. Mirrors the same guard used in _apply_profile_override().
